claim: The frozen G2 result is a five-pair textual-distinguishability ceiling for the measured genome pairs. It is not a complete ten-pair matrix and does not by itself establish semantic specificity or propagation through life.

pairConstraintsForH.interpretation: A null or weak H difference for Thread 3 versus Thread 4 is uninformative about failure of lived-history or genome propagation because the direct-visibility G2 ceiling for this pair was itself inconclusive at 15/24. Do not call either genome individually weak: slot 3 is detectable on p02 and slot 4 is strong on p04.

hUsePolicy.rule: H may use G2 as a genome-specificity ceiling only for p01-p05. Unmeasured pairs may be inspected descriptively but may not receive a G2-normalized genome-specificity interpretation unless a separately frozen complementary-cycle experiment is run first.
hUsePolicy.reason: G2 already provides a valid screening ceiling with every genome observed on two measured edges. Running the complementary cycle is unnecessary unless H later requires ceiling-backed inference for an unmeasured pair.

coverageInterpretation.note: With exactly one failing edge in a five-cycle, every vertex is automatically incident to at least one detectable edge. The per-genome edge profile is the more informative observed evidence that no single genome is inert as text.

chanceReference.assumption: independent pair-detection events under a chance 0.5 rater
chanceReference.interpretation: Reference arithmetic only. It supports that the frozen rule is not permissive under the independent-edge chance model; it does not assert that empirical edge outcomes are independent.

lexicalOverlapDiagnostic.purpose: Bound how much blind-rater success tracks exact distinctive-token reuse. This cannot upgrade the ceiling from textual distinguishability to semantic specificity.
